title: Too small to be useful and cheap quality
text: Too small to be useful and cheap quality. I bought this for someone who loves anything Pioneer Woman. She ended up using the small bag for storing office supplies, and sticking the large bag and bottle in a junk drawer. The large lunch bag's bottom is too narrow for most plastic containers. If you are bringing a TV dinner or sandwich to work, this will suffice, but other than that you will have to stand your storage container on it's side to fit. the bottle is a very cheap, thin, non-insulated metal bottle which means it gets very hot or cold to hold, depending on what's in it.

product_metadata.title: The Pioneer Woman Insulated Lunch Tote, Mini Bag and Water Bottle - Traveling Vines
description: Enjoy all of your favorite Pioneer Woman designs beyond the comfort of your home. This Pioneer Woman travel set includes an insulated tote with a built-in handle, a smaller zip-close clutch and a matching hydrating bottle. To clean, please hand wash only!
